473:t_3:22.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's my way of thanking you for always training me.」

473:t_3:23.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So that punch today is the result of that, huh? Thanks to it, I'm wide awake now.」

473:t_3:24.en:
$$竜馬$$
「...is what I'd like to say, but you've still got a long way to go. If you're going to do it, take me down in one hit the instant I go berserk.」

473:t_3:25.en:
$$甲児$$
「Oss! Then, if it's all right, could you start my training right away?」

473:t_3:26.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Sure. Let's work up a sweat before we eat.」

473:t_3:27.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$n, $$アマタ$$! I'll take care of you two along with $$甲児$$!」

473:t_3:31.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Y-yeah...! I'll do it... $$ミコノ$$!」

473:t_3:35.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That works. Try making your three hearts one.」

473:t_3:36.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's go, everyone! Now that it's settled, dash to the hangar!」

473:t_3:37.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Looks like we needn't worry about $$竜馬$$.」

473:t_3:38.en:
$$隼人$$
「He seems to be shrugging off even the challenge from $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$.」

473:t_3:39.en:
$$號$$
「That's as it should be. If fear and anxiety freeze your feet, you can't move forward.」

473:t_3:40.en:
$$隼人$$
「But sooner or later... we'll have to settle things with the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s.」

473:t_3:41.en:
$$弁慶$$
「The dimensional rift at the center of the galaxy...」

473:t_3:42.en:
$$隼人$$
「Will that be where we fight our decisive battle with them?」

473:t_3:43.en:
$$號$$
(And all of the $$インベーダー#pilot$$s' secrets are probably hidden there...)

473:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z that were produced when Mr. $$ロジャー$$ fought with Mr. $$竜馬$$... I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

473:t_10:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Your passion for $$Ｚチップ$$ is as strong as ever.」

473:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But it's an unexpected pairing. Mr. $$ロジャー$$ and Mr. $$竜馬$$, I mean.」

473:t_10:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Not really. In fiction, a combination of the brainy type and the brawny type is a classic, is it not?」

473:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What!? Mr. $$竜馬$$ is the brainy type!?」

473:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「H-hey...! It's not funny when you're aiming your wristwatch at me!」

473:t_10:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It seems I took the joke a little too far.」

473:t_10:11.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Still, somehow I get along with him. Perhaps because we both wear black.」

473:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that case, a fiery soul may be slumbering inside Mr. $$ロジャー$$ too.」

473:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What do you say? Since you've been assigned to this unit, why not try shouting with passion?」

473:t_10:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Very well, I shall show off my fine voice.」

473:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There is one person over there who looks thoroughly put off.」

473:t_10:23.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's a misunderstanding. This was merely a sort of entertainment...」

473:t_10:24.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「You two... are the worst.」

473:t_10:25.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$Ｒ．ドロシー・ウェインライト$$!」

473:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Do your best, Mr. $$ロジャー$$. Please get through this pinch with your specialty, negotiation.」

473:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Still, it was a surprise. So deep down, Mr. $$竜馬$$ was grateful for friendship too.」

473:t_10:32.en:
$$竜馬$$
「These past few days, I've let you see me at my worst one time after another.」

473:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Human fate is a strange thing. Mr. $$竜馬$$, who values friendship so much, might have done well even in a team sport.」

473:t_10:36.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But the past can't be changed. I chose the path of kicking bad guys around instead of kicking a ball.」

473:t_10:37.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Well, even so, when there's something round in front of me, there are times I feel like kicking it into the dust chute.」

473:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Undeterred by that, let's give it our all again today...」

473:t_10:42.en:
$$竜馬$$
「To make up for the trouble I caused everyone around me, today's service is special.」

474:t_000:0.en:
$$シモン$$
「Treatment with $$ゲッター線$$, huh...」

474:t_000:1.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Is it really going to be all right?」

474:t_000:2.en:
$$ギミー$$
「We've come this far, so we have no choice but to do it. Let's trust in $$竜馬$$'s life force.」

474:t_000:3.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...So, thinking about the worst case, the place you picked is here, huh.」

474:t_000:4.en:
$$シンジ$$
「So this is where $$第３新東京市$$ used to be...」

474:t_000:5.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Well, Brat $$シンジ$$? How does it feel to stand here again?」

474:t_000:7.en:
$n
「Stop it, $$アスカ$$. Sure, it may be because of the effects of that incident that your world was transferred out of this one, but...」

474:t_000:8.en:
$n
「$$シンジ$$ did everything he could to try to save $$レイ#pt394$$.」

474:t_000:9.en:
$$アスカ$$
「One person's life is heavier than the Earth... huh.」

474:t_001:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「It's just as $$隼人$$ said. The enemy really has come.」

474:t_001:1.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Approaching force confirmed... It's the $$新地球皇国$$ army.」

474:t_003:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「What's with that reluctant tone!?」

474:t_003:2.en:
$$メール$$
「But, Darling! $$ハイアデス$$ isn't here!」

474:t_003:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「My mission today is to investigate your combat strength.」

474:t_003:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...That was my intention, but I've changed my mind.」

473:t_3:35 / 33: 三つの心を一つに read as Amata + Kagura + Apollo (Aquarion trio) making 3 hearts one; row 33 相手 = 'training partners'
